steps.title: Analyze Build Failures
steps.description: Inspect error logs regarding manifest merging and incorrect key attributes.

steps.title: Sanitize AndroidManifest Namespace
steps.description: Rewrite AndroidManifest.xml with proper, clean XML standards to avoid parsing issues with android:name.

steps.title: Clean build.gradle Configuration
steps.description: Clean the build configuration to align compilation properties with target and compile versions.

steps.title: Remove Prohibited External Dependencies
steps.description: Remove nanohttpd and other non-standard external dependencies from build.gradle to satisfy strict rules.

steps.title: Validate Java Source Code
steps.description: Ensure MainActivity is correctly defined within the package and matches package metadata.

steps.title: Validate Layout Resource XML
steps.description: Ensure layout activity_main.xml compiles successfully with the correct text element.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Toolchain settings
steps.description: Check and enforce compatibility rules for Java 1.8 in the build environment.

steps.title: Match Package Metadata
steps.description: Verify app-meta.json consistently reflects the correct application name and package identifier.

steps.title: Perform Manifest Verification Check
steps.description: Double check manifest elements for missing attributes or invalid characters prior to building.

steps.title: Building Compile Fail Demo
steps.description: Assemble the project to verify successful generation of the debug APK.
